previous_years_questions.question_type: Section A (1 Mark Short Note / Provision)
previous_years_questions.question: What is the rate of interest payable on a loan given by a partner to the firm if there is no partnership agreement?
previous_years_questions.solution: Answer: Interest at the rate of 6% per annum is payable on a partner's loan in the absence of an agreement (Section 16, Indian Partnership Act, 1932).

previous_years_questions.question: Why is Profit and Loss Appropriation Account prepared? State one reason.
previous_years_questions.solution: Answer: Profit and Loss Appropriation Account is prepared to show how the net profit of the firm is distributed among partners in the form of interest on capital, salaries, reserves, and profit shares.

previous_years_questions.question: X, Y and Z are partners sharing profits in 5:3:2. Z is guaranteed a minimum profit of ₹10,000 per year. Net profit for the year is ₹40,000. Show the distribution of profit.
Under which method of Capital Accounts are drawings recorded on the debit side of Current Account?
previous_years_questions.solution: Answer: Under the Fixed Capital Method.

previous_years_questions.question: Define Partnership Deed.
previous_years_questions.solution: Answer: Partnership Deed is a written document signed by all partners that contains terms and conditions, profit ratios, capitals, and operational guidelines of the partnership firm.
